question: What traces of disc burning are there?
english: CD-burn trace in the System event log: cdrom driver event 133 for \Device\CdRom0 (2015-03-24 20:24:46 UTC). Windows leaves this trace when it writes a disc; it does not show what was written (heuristic rule R12).
